name: Lunar unilluminated-night audit

original_specification.name: Lunar unilluminated-night audit
original_specification.description: A proposed lighting arrangement for checking absence of undeclared lighting.
original_specification.sources: No rig lights and no assumed environmental illumination
original_specification.geometry: Existing local sources must be explicitly listed or disabled for this audit
original_specification.contribution_policy: Zero added energy; bright details require an identified real source
original_specification.authoring_method: Original lunar authoring concept. Solar directions and relative contributions are illustrative inputs, not site ephemerides or measured lunar photometry. No atmospheric sky, haze or automatic ambient fill is permitted in physical mode.
validation: Do not brighten darkness using an invented sky or autoexposure

scale_policy: Scale light positions/sizes once to an explicitly selected subject; never scale the subject.
limitations: Vacuum mode: no atmospheric sky, fog, star dome or undeclared ambient light.
Solar direction and radiance are authored relative values, not site ephemerides or measured lunar photometry.
